newsitem.title: UK: UK's JJB Sports says sales figure was right.
newsitem.headline: UK's JJB Sports says sales figure was right.

text.p: Britain's JJB Sports Plc reiterated on Friday that its like-for-like sales in the 22 weeks to June 29, 1997 had risen 18 percent in trade growth that materially exceeded its expectations.

The company said its turnover was up 60 percent during the same period and, contrary to press reports, it had no reason to change its trading statement which was announced during the annual meeting of shareholders last month.
The company's share price had fallen to a day's low of 418p on Friday before rising again to 453 1/2p before mid-day.
